titulo: Taylor Farms pulls iceberg lettuce from the US market after cyclosporiasis outbreak
cuerpo: Food producer Taylor Farms released a statement on the Cyclospora outbreak Friday, confirming that it's "voluntarily removing all iceberg lettuce sourced from central Mexico from the US market."
